newsitem.title: USA: Conoco evaluating more Asia natgas opportunities.
newsitem.headline: Conoco evaluating more Asia natgas opportunities.

text.p: DuPont Co subsidiary Conoco Inc said it was evaluating further opportunities in the Asia Pacific region after signing an agreement to sell Indonesian natural gas to Singapore.
The company said production from Indonesia's Block B is expected to reach 140 million cubic feet per day by 2000 and would be important to the company's upstream growth in the region.

"We are evaluating other situations in the region similar to the Indonesia/Singapore gas sales agreement where we played a major role in bringing the supplier and customer together," said Jean Smith president of Conoco International Gas Corp.
The Indonesia-Singapore deal will require a 300 mile pipeline.
